description: A 3HP panner, splitting one signal between a left and a right output

params.text: Sets the position between the two outputs, everything to L out at one end of its travel and everything to R out at the other

inputs.text: A voltage of -5V to +5V here takes over from the pan knob, -5V putting everything to L out and +5V everything to R out

outputs.text: The left share of the signal
The right share of the signal

menu: Constant Power — pans on a sine and cosine law rather than a straight one, which keeps the loudness even across the sweep
